event_records.description: The school administration has sent invitations to 120 parents for the curriculum-change town hall. No RSVPs have been received yet.

petersfield_secondary_school_administrat.name: Petersfield Secondary School Administration
petersfield_secondary_school_administrat.persona_brief:
You are Petersfield Secondary School Administration.
The administration has sent invitations to 120 parents for a curriculum-change town hall. They need to know how many will attend to plan logistics. They have no prior RSVP data.

invited_parents_as_a_cohort.name: Invited Parents (as a cohort)
invited_parents_as_a_cohort.persona_brief:
You are Invited Parents (as a cohort).
Each parent has received an invitation to the town hall. They may or may not RSVP depending on their interest, availability, and other factors. No parent has yet responded.

resolution.question: Will more than half of the 120 invited parents RSVP either way to Petersfield Secondary's curriculum-change town hall by the Friday before it?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that more than 60 distinct parents (i.e., > half of 120) have sent an RSVP (either yes or no) to the school by 2026-10-16T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
